children: Gold.com reported fiscal year 2026 net income attributable to the company of $82.3 million and diluted earnings per share of $3.02 for the year ended June 30, 2026. Revenue for FY2026 rose to $25.513 billion and non-GAAP EBITDA totaled $179.8 million. The board declared a special cash dividend of $1.00 per share and maintained the quarterly dividend at $0.20 per share.
Gross profit (Year ended June 30, 2026): $453,144 (in thousands); gross profit margin 1.78% of revenue
Net income attributable to the company (FY2026): $82,341 (in thousands); diluted EPS: $3.02
Non-GAAP measures (FY2026): Adjusted net income before provision for income taxes $139,940 (in thousands); EBITDA $179,750 (in thousands)
Dividends: Special cash dividend of $1.00 per share declared payable September 28, 2026; quarterly cash dividend maintained at $0.20 per share
Completed acquisition of Sunshine Minting in April 2026, expanding production capacity and minting capabilities to serve sovereign mints and other customers.
Reported operational growth across storage and secured lending businesses, strengthening customer relationships and cross-platform engagement.
Direct-to-Consumer segment continued to contribute the majority of consolidated gross profit (66% in Q4 2026; 69% for FY2026) and showed higher average order values year-over-year.
Gold ounces sold (Q4 2026): 521,000 ounces (up 51% year-over-year); fiscal year gold ounces sold: 2,032,000 (up 24% year-over-year).
Expanded platform reach through prior and recent acquisitions (SGI, Pinehurst, AMS, Monex and SMI), enhancing trading, logistics and minting integration across the value chain.
